content: WhatsApp-first calorie tracking is a validated, crowded category: ZapDieta, ContaCal, Gluti (all Brazilian, Portuguese-first, paid subscriptions), plus kcalm, CaloriChat, CalorAI (international). Common features: natural language meal logging, meal photo logging, voice notes, instant macro reply in chat, exercise logging, weekly progress reports in chat, no app install. kcalm shows confidence grading per ingredient with editable estimates. Flex Diet differentiator: personal, free, TACO-native, full data ownership, MCP interface instead of closed bot.
